justification: Both full npm trees and production web dependencies now pass raw npm audit with zero advisories. The previous development-only exception is retired. Legacy build consumers use explicit project-owned API glue backed by patched minimatch 11.0.1; modern consumers use 11.0.1 directly. Capacitor/rimraf uses patched glob 14.0.3. See docs/DEPENDENCY_AUDIT_2026-11-03.md.
